en:
Kokichi, are we going to play
more games today—

Hey, Shuichi!
Let's have a tea party today!
What? A tea party?

Can we do it, pwetty pweeeease? Well, we're
gonna do it so let's go to the dining hall!
W-Wait, Kokichi!

Mmhm, this is pleasant. I feel like my soul
is coming back to my body!
O-Okay...

My organization requires everyone to have
an afternoon break. It increases productivity.

Ah. That sounds like a rather...
peaceful organization.

Yup. The supreme leader, *ahem* me, is a
pacifist. That's why I settle fights with games.

By the way, everyone who lost to me should
be working hard in Siberia right now.
<CLT=cltMIND>Siberia!?
Well, if they're even alive!
<CLT=cltMIND>*If* they're alive!?

Don't worry, Shuichi. 
You'll be in heaven rather than Siberia.
...I would prefer not to be.
Mmm... Well...

How about you just join my organization?
If you were a member, there'd be no problem.
I am going to have to decline...
What's your game, Kokichi?
The organization is a lie, isn't it?
Are you unsure of something?

You're a pretty interesting guy,
so I think joining might be good for you.
I am going to have to decline...

Whaaaat?
I thought you wanted to live, Shuichi!

I do! But I could never join some
nefarious organization...

Ah-haha! I guess that's true!
But that's sorta disappointing.

If someone like you joined,
I would never get bored.
What's your game, Kokichi?

What d'ya mean, "What's your game?"
I just want you to be my sacrificial hitman.
A "sacrificial hitman"!?

The sole act of killing is a waste. Learning the
value of wasting men is more important!
<CLT=cltMIND>It's killing either way!
The organization is a lie, isn't it?

Hm, why do you think it's a lie?
Are you thaaaat paranoid it's a trick?
No one likes being tricked, Kokichi.
Oh, really?

Trick the entire world, and it will become the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=cltNORMAL>. The real <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=cltNORMAL> isn't that great anyway.
Trick the entire world?

The world could be tricking you right now,
and you wouldn't even know it.
...But, I could also be lying about that.
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
So...I think I'm gonna head out.

By the way, are you sure it was okay to waste
this event without playing a game?
Huh?

Now there's one less chance for you to
survive, y'know?

I already told you that you only have three
events left. But you seem pretty relaxed.

W-Wait a minute, you're the one who
said we should drink tea today!

So you're blaming me?
Yeah sure, whatever!
What!?

Ah-haha! Right there, Shuichi!
That's the face I wanted to see!

I'm the supreme leader of evil!
I crush people's hopes and dreams!

Now since I took my snack break,
I should be able to work hard today!
Nee-heeheehee!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>I shook off Kokichi's cheeky laughter,
and I returned to my room.
